999008199.text: どっちに味方するかって……そんな質問は――

localizations.en: Which side will I take...? That's not a question I—

999008199.text:
片や、親の命令に従って、不穏分子を排除するために
暗躍してきた管理者

localizations.en: On one side, you have agents of the Palme, who secretly manipulated and eliminated threats on their parents' orders.

999008199.text:
片や、それが管理されていたものとは知らず、
自国の過去の姿に憧れるお殿様

localizations.en: And on the other, a lord who never knew she was being controlled—who thought her nation's past glories were earned through its own efforts, not realizing they were orchestrated all along.

999008199.text: その二人が手を取り合うなんて、ありえないよねぇ？

localizations.en: There's no way those two could ever join hands, right?

999008199.text:
ちょっと待ったー！　急に出てきたと思ったら……
なんでアンタが仕切ってるのよ偉そうに！

localizations.en: Hold on a second! You just show up out of nowhere just to play the high and mighty mediator?!

999008199.text:
そうでもしないとこの場は収まらないじゃないか、
オカリーナ

localizations.en: Well, someone has to settle things, don't they, little ocarina?

999008199.text: アルビーナな。誰が笛じゃ。アンタ引っ込みなさいよ

localizations.en: It's Alvina! And did you just call me a flute? Butt out already!

999008199.text:
君だって、アウグストのやり方に
思うところがないわけじゃないだろう？

localizations.en: You're not entirely happy with August's methods either, are you?

999008199.text: それは……

で、どうレスナ。答えを聞かせてよ。
どっちの味方をするのかさ

localizations.en: So, how about it, Resna? Let me hear your answer. Which side are you on?

999008199.text:
私は……どちらにも肩入れしますし、
どちらにも肩入れしません

localizations.en: I'm... on both sides, and also neither.

999008199.text:
イェルカさんが、これからまた誰かを管理しようと
言うのなら、私は止めます

localizations.en: If Jelka tries to manage anyone again, I'll stop her.

999008199.text:
その上で、鏑矢さんがイェルカさんを許せず
戦おうとするのなら、それも止めます

localizations.en: But if Kaburaya tries to start a fight over past deeds, I'll stop that too.

999008199.text:
そして、お互いにとっていい答えが見つかるまで……
とことん話し合います

localizations.en: And until we find an answer that works for everyone... we'll keep talking it through.

999008199.text:
……それはどっちにもいい顔しすぎじゃないの？
僕はどっちの味方をするか聞いてるんだけど？

localizations.en: ...That's such a non-committal answer. I asked you to choose one.

999008199.text:
甘い考えなのは分かっています……でも！
それでも、私はみんなを幸せにしたい

localizations.en: I know it sounds naive... but still! I believe we can arrive at an outcome that we can all accept.

999008199.text:
みんなの味方でいたいって？
そんなのは自惚れだよ

localizations.en: You think you can please everyone? Are you some saint? That's either arrogance or overconfidence.

999008199.text:
いいえ……
私はただ、自分が信じる道を曲げたくないだけ

localizations.en: It's just that... I genuinely believe we can all get along and won't compromise on that belief.

999008199.text: 私は、私の味方でいきます！

localizations.en: For me, that's staying true to myself!

999008199.text: ……それがレスナ、お前の信念なのだな

localizations.en: ...So, you are determined to hold that position, Resna?

999008199.text: はい

まったく、世の中には余に並ぶうつけがいたか。
ここは引こう。レスナにはケイウンでの恩もあるしな

localizations.en: My word. To think there exists another naive fool on my level. Very well. I shall back down. I am indebted to you for what happened in Keiun, after all.

999008199.text:
あ……ありがとうございます！
ほめてくれたんですよね……？

localizations.en: Th-Thank you so much! Wait, that was a compliment, right...?

999008199.text: だとさ、シトリン

えー、何それ！　思ってたのと違うっていうか……
ぜんぜんつまんないんだけど？

localizations.en: Huh? What is this? That's not how it was supposed to turn out... Ugh, how trite.

999008199.text:
おあいにく様、世界はアンタが楽しいように
できてるわけじゃないってこと！

localizations.en: Too bad! The world doesn't exist for your entertainment!

999008199.text:
これ以上引っかき回すつもりなら……
捕まえてがっつり懲らしめてあげるんだから！

localizations.en: If you're gonna keep stirring up trouble, you better watch out! You'll going to get an earful from me.

999008199.text:
おっと、ここで捕まるわけにはいかないよ。
じゃあ、僕はこれで

localizations.en: Uhh... that doesn't sound very appearling. Well then, it's time for me to step back.

999008199.text: ゴゥ、イェルカ、一緒に帰るかい？

localizations.en: Gou, Jelka, care to join me?

999008199.text: 私は――

アタシは帰らないよ。
鏑矢流に言えば、これがアタシの信念だから

localizations.en: Count me out. I'm determined to stay.

999008199.text:
む……ならば私も姉上についていきます。
今の姉上を放ってはおけません

localizations.en: Mm... Then I'll have to stay by her side. I can't leave her by herself right now.

999008199.text: それに……私としても、気になることがあるので

localizations.en: Besides... there are things I'm curious about too.

999008199.text: そ。じゃあ、またね

localizations.en: I see. Well then, til' next time.

999008199.text:
……そうやって甘いことを言っていられるのも、
今のうちだけかもね

localizations.en: ...Enjoy your idealism while it lasts. Reality has a way of catching up.

999008199.text: 待てぃこの野郎
おーーっとっと

localizations.en: Oops, that's my cue to go!
